itens.descricao: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1, up to a maximum of 20.

efeitos.descricao:
Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain expertise in Deception and Performance.
You gain a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be Surprised.

itens.descricao: Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

efeitos.descricao:
When you are Prone, standing up uses significantly less movement.
Your Jump distance also increases by 50%.
Charge forward and slam your weapon into the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Charge forward and Shove the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Shove distance depends on your Strength and the target's weight.
When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the attack rolls do not have Disadvantage.
Your Piercing Shot also inflicts Gaping Wounds for twice as long.

When you are attacked with a melee attack while wielding a Finesse weapon you are proficient in, you can use a Reaction to increase your Armour Class by your proficiency bonus, possibly causing the attack to miss.

You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if your weapons aren't Light.
You cannot dual-wield Two-Handed weapons.
You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wielding a melee weapon in each hand.
You gain Advantage on Perception checks made to detect hidden objects and on saving throws made to avoid or resist traps.
You gain resistance to the damage dealt by traps.

Your Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Regain full hit points every time you take a short rest.

itens.descricao:
Elemental Adept
Your spells and attacks ignore resistance to a damage type of your choice. In addition, when you deal that type of damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
The available passive features are:
Elemental Adept: Acid
Elemental Adept: Cold
Elemental Adept: Lightning
Elemental Adept: Fire
Elemental Adept: Thunder

efeitos.descricao: When an attack with a melee weapon lands a critical hit or kills a creature, you can make another melee weapon attack as a Bonus that turn.
When attacking with a Two-Handed or Versatile melee weapon (in both hands) that you are proficient with, attack rolls take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.

Your Strength ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Gain proficiency with HeavyArmour.

Your Strength ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Incoming damage from non-magical attacks also decreases by 3 while you're wearing heavy armour.

itens.descricao: Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

efeitos.descricao: Gain proficiency with LightArmour.

itens.descricao: You gain 3 lps that recharge after a long rest.

efeitos.descricao: You can use a Luck Point to gain Advantage on your next ability check.
You can use a Luck Point to gain Advantage on your next attack roll or saving throw, or to make an enemy reroll their attack roll.
When a creature casts a spell within melee range of you, you have Advantage on any saving throws against it.
You can use a Reaction to immediately make an attack against the caster if it casts a spell within Dist of you.
Enemies you hit have Disadvantage when making saving throws to maintain their Concentration.
Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level spell from the Bard spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per long rest. Your spellcasting ability for all three spells is Charisma.
Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level spell from the Cleric spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per long rest. Your spellcasting ability for all three spells is Wisdom.
Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level spell from the Druid spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per long rest. Your spellcasting ability for all three spells is Wisdom.
Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level spell from the Sorcerer spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per long rest. Your spellcasting ability for all three spells is Charisma.
Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level spell from the Warlock spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per long rest. Your spellcasting ability for all three spells is Charisma.
Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level spell from the Wizard spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per long rest. Your spellcasting ability for all three spells is Intelligence.
Learn two Manoeuvres from the Battle Master archetype and receive 1 (additional) Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a short or long rest.
When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.
Your movement speed increases by Dist.
When you use the Dash action, Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down.
If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke an Opportunity Attack from that target.

itens.descricao: Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

efeitos.descricao: Gain proficiency with MediumArmour and Shields.

itens.descricao:
Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Gain Instruments proficiency.

efeitos.descricao: When attacking with a Glaives Glaive, Halberds Halberd, Pikes Pike, Quarterstaves Quarterstaff, or Spears Spear, you can use a Bonus to attack with the butt of your weapon.
You can also make an Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range.

itens.descricao:
Resilient
You increase an ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Gain proficiency in that ability's saving throws.
The available passive features are:
Resilient: Strength
Resilient: Dexterity
Resilient: Constitution
Resilient: Intelligence
Resilient: Wisdom
Resilient: Charisma

efeitos.descricao: You learn two Ritual spells of your choice.
When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.
When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.
When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.
You gain Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.
Your ranged weapon attacks are not penalized for High Ground Rules.
Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are proficient with have a -5 penalty to their attack roll, but deal an additional 10 damage.
Gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity when wielding a shield.

If a spell forces you to make a Dexterity, you can use your Reaction to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage.
* On a failed save, you only take half damage.
* On a successful save, you don't take any damage, even if you normally would.
You gain proficiency in 3 skills of your choice.
You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a critical hit while attacking with a spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

itens.descricao: Your Strength or Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

efeitos.descricao: When you make an unarmed attack, use an improvised weapon, or throw something, your strength modifier is added twice to the damage and attack roll.
Hit point maximum increased by 2 for each level.
You gain Advantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration on a spell.
You can also use a Reaction to cast Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.

itens.descricao: Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

efeitos.descricao: Gain proficiency with four weapon types of your choice.
